svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Congestion on Songdo roads by hour
svg.text: Congestion on Songdo roads by hour (traffic model)
Travel time / free-flow time. Each direction is drawn on its own side of the road (keep right); big roads thicker. Black ring = centre of Songdo.
Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. Traffic is a model (src/roads.py).
